metadata.title: Is Seedance Open Source? GitHub, Hugging Face, ComfyUI & Local Use
metadata.description: Clarify Seedance open-source, GitHub, Hugging Face, ComfyUI, local-model, weights, and VRAM questions without presenting unofficial files as official releases.

hero.title: Is Seedance Open Source?
hero.description: A source-aware answer to “is Seedance 2.0 open source?” and “is Seedance 2.5 open source?”—including official status, third-party projects, hosted APIs, and local-use limits.
hero.tip: Do not download or run a model because a repository uses the Seedance name. Verify ownership, licensing, provenance, safety, and the current official release.

introduce.title: Open source is a specific claim
introduce.description: A model can have public demos, an API, sample prompts, or community tooling without releasing official weights under an open-source license.

items.title: Official weights
items.description: Look for a ByteDance Seed release that explicitly provides weights, license terms, model files, and supported hardware.

items.title: Official API
items.description: Hosted API access is useful for development but does not mean the underlying model is locally downloadable or open source.

items.title: Community repositories
items.description: GitHub, Hugging Face, and ComfyUI projects may provide workflows, wrappers, adapters, or unrelated models using a similar name.

items.title: Local execution
items.description: A local workflow requires official weights, compatible code, hardware, license permission, and an end-to-end install path.

benefits.title: How to assess an open-source Seedance result
benefits.description: Use an evidence checklist for searches about Seedance GitHub, Hugging Face, ComfyUI, VRAM, and local models.

items.title: Check the publisher
items.description: Confirm whether the repository is owned or linked by ByteDance Seed, a named provider, or an unaffiliated account.

items.title: Check the license
items.description: Read redistribution, commercial use, model-output, dataset, and modification terms.

items.title: Check the artifact
items.description: Distinguish model weights from a prompt tool, UI workflow, API client, demo video, or checkpoint for another model.

items.title: Check the risk
items.description: Avoid unknown binaries, credential requests, unverified downloads, and instructions that claim to bypass moderation or rights controls.

features.title: Open-source research checklist
features.description: This keeps the answer accurate when a new community project appears under a familiar Seedance keyword.

items.title: Official announcement
items.description: Search the ByteDance Seed model pages and release notes for an explicit open-weight statement.

items.title: Version identity
items.description: Check whether the reference is Seedance 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, or a different Seed-family model.

items.title: License and terms
items.description: Confirm what “open” permits for research, commercial work, redistribution, and fine-tuning.

items.title: Hardware requirements
items.description: Only use published VRAM, format, runtime, and performance requirements from the official release.

items.title: Provenance
items.description: Prefer signed or linked releases and inspect dependencies before running code.

items.title: Fallback access
items.description: If weights are not officially released, use a supported hosted product or API instead of a questionable download.

faq.title: Is Seedance Open Source FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: Is Seedance 2.0 open source?
items.answer: Do not assume it is open source because it has APIs, demos, or community workflows. Check ByteDance Seed’s current official release and license information for any weight release.

items.question: Is Seedance 2.5 open source?
items.answer: The official model pages describe hosted model capabilities and provider access. A GitHub or Hugging Face project is not an official open-weight release unless the publisher and license say so.

items.question: Is there a Seedance 2.5 Huggingface model?
items.answer: Community uploads and similarly named projects may exist, but verify the publisher, license, weights, version, and provenance before downloading or using one.

items.question: Can I run Seedance in ComfyUI locally?
items.answer: Only if an official compatible model, license, runtime, and workflow are available. A ComfyUI node or API wrapper alone does not provide the original model locally.

items.question: How much VRAM does Seedance need?
items.answer: There is no responsible universal number without an official local release and runtime specification. Do not treat a third-party estimate as an official hardware requirement.

items.question: Where is the official Seedance GitHub?
items.answer: Use ByteDance Seed’s official model pages and linked documentation as the starting point. Avoid repositories that request secrets or advertise moderation bypasses.

cta.title: Verify before you download
cta.description: Use an official provider or API when local weights and licensing are not clearly published, and keep third-party projects separate from the model owner.
